text: adversarial finding: Every residue can hold while a player who dies never comes back: the play probe runs in god mode, so the checkpoints and the mod's respawn are never exercised in 06's layered geometry (a cap, the deck, the tower).
adversarial finding: boat-run only proves the boat goes east; 'vehicles fit and can leave' also needs it to back out of the lane's end and return west.
adversarial finding: The command room is only reached through the tower's own ladder shaft, but the objective test teleports into it; the tower climb itself is never played.
adversarial finding: look-dusk-palette measures colour only: an image of mostly sky-coloured emptiness could pass it. The structure (bands top to bottom, where the detail is) must match too.
adversarial finding: The emergent property 'each foundation reads as a distinct fight with cover, height and a flank' has no residue: the caps as first built are flat slabs.

adversarial finding: coop-two can pass while guests can't use the ladders (the ladder code moves characters on the host from their controllers' inputs; a guest's input path differs from the host's keyboard).
adversarial finding: Editor saveability: the level is built only from the editor's own templates plus registered mod entities, which the linter parses; no separate residue needed.
adversarial finding: The hanging-container jump chain is an optional route; the linter proves the jumps are within the rules. Not material.
adversarial finding: 'CS enemies hold every layer' has no residue: all enemies could sit on one layer and every other residue still hold.
adversarial finding: 'CS patrol boats drive the lane by autopilot' is unverified in 06: the boat test only records where the patrols ended.
adversarial finding: Co-op strength for 3 and 4 players rests on the names: nothing checks that 06 has enough [2+] and [3+] enemies to scale.

adversarial finding: Round 3: with respawn, the boat backing out, the tower climb, structure as well as palette, cap cover, guest ladders, layers held, patrols and co-op names covered, nothing material is left that no residue would catch. The remaining risk is in the probes themselves (a harness test that passes for the wrong reason), which FINAL_VERIFY re-examines against the evidence.
